name: dual-review
description: Two blind reviews on different models, a refuter for what only one saw, a fix of only the confirmed findings, and a re-check of each one; two rounds, then the person

steps.title: First review
steps.prompt:
Review, without changing any file: {target}

You are one of two reviewers working apart: find the real problems on your own. Report each one in `findings`, with its place, its evidence and whether the change caused it. Say plainly when there is none.

steps.title: Second review
steps.prompt:
Review, without changing any file: {target}

You are one of two reviewers working apart: find the real problems on your own. Report each one in `findings`, with its place, its evidence and whether the change caused it. Say plainly when there is none.

steps.title: Decide what only one saw
steps.prompt: Decide, without changing any file, the findings on: {target}

steps.title: Fix the confirmed findings
steps.prompt: Fix, in: {target}, the confirmed findings below.

steps.title: Check each fix
steps.prompt: Check, without changing any file, the fix just made in: {target}
